title: capability_denied
description: The agent refused a request because a capability or a server module is off on this device, because the device is not enrolled, or because the agent does not implement it (Linux agent). The server writes an audit event, raises a notification and forwards it to the panels. With `task_id` the task becomes `Denied`; with `transfer_id` (capability `files`) the file transfer becomes `rejected` and the device's file capability is stored as off. Agents send the same capability/action/reason at most once a minute, except when `task_id` or `transfer_id` is set (the server closes the task or the transfer from it).

capability.description: terminal, vision, patches, wol, files or exam (Windows agent); terminal, vision, quarantine, patches or wol (Linux agent); deploy for a `winget_install` refused because the lab's deploy module is off; power for a refused `power`, message for a refused `user_message` (local capabilities, on by default).

action.description: What was refused: a server action (execute, winget_install, power, user_message, start_vision_session, start_stream, wake_peer, scan_updates, install_updates, file_push, file_pull, exam_mode; lockdown and unlock from the Linux agent), a remote_input sub-command (get_thumbnail, set_fps, remote_input) or vision_tunnel (the tray asked for the Vision channel).

transfer_id.description: Only for a refused `file_push` or `file_pull`: the transfer from that message.

reason.description: 0.1.12+. Missing = local capability policy; "module_disabled" = the server module is off for the device's lab; "not_enrolled" = no device secret, so the Vision channel was not opened. "not_supported" = the agent does not implement the action (Linux agent: quarantine, Vision, Windows Update); for `quarantine` from a secret-authenticated Linux agent the server clears the device's quarantine flag and pending action.
